releases.notes:
## What's New in 1.6.0

### New
- **Radial Menu:** hold `V` and a pie menu opens around your crosshair with quick commands: `/spawn`, `/tpa` and `/tpaccept`. Move towards a slice and let go of the key to run it. Let go in the middle or press `Esc` to cancel.
- It follows **Tournament Mode** and **PvP Command Lock**, so a blocked command stays blocked.

### Improved
- **Spawn Escape** and **TP Danger Escape** now show a note when you switch them on: they work well, but can sometimes send `/spawn` when a friend teleports you to them.

### Fixed
- Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock no longer turn on when the server announces that **another player** left the game in PvP mode and was killed.
- The default `pvpModePattern` no longer matches every line that contains "PvP mode". Old configs with the old default are updated automatically.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer
- Fabric API
- Java 25 or newer

Don't install the standalone WorldEditCUI mod alongside this one, it's already built in.

Questions or bugs? Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/ApRvuNsX3j).

releases.notes:
## MineBerry - Essentials 1.5.0

Tournament Mode, a command lock for PvP, and a fix so Safe Logout can't lock you in.

### Added
- Tournament Mode: blocks every command, so nobody types one by accident and gets teleported into another gamemode.
  - Off by default, switch it on from the Safety tab in the Control Center.
  - Also blocks commands from clickable chat messages and the ones the mod sends itself, like Spawn Escape.
  - A red TOURNAMENT MODE box on the HUD shows while it's on.
- PvP Command Lock: while you're in PvP mode, only /r, /reply, /msg, /m, /w, /tell and /cc work.
  - Everything else is blocked until the server says you're out of PvP mode.
  - Works even if Safe Logout is turned off.
- Safe Logout: an "I'm safe - unlock" button in the pause menu ends the guard right away.

### Improved
- Safe Logout now also reads the "out of PvP mode" message when the server sends it in the action bar.

### Fixed
- Safe Logout could keep you locked in if the "out of PvP mode" message was missed. It now lets go by itself after 3 minutes.

### Config
- pvpAllowedCommands: the commands that still work in PvP mode.
- tournamentAllowedCommands: the commands that still work in Tournament Mode (empty by default).
- pvpFailsafeSeconds: how long until Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock let go on their own (180 by default).

### Install
Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API and Java 25 or newer. Put the jar and Fabric API in your mods folder.

Full feature list and FAQ are in the README.

## MineBerry - Essentials 1.4.5

Screenshots that paste straight into Discord, a chat history search, and a fix for Safe Logout.

### Added
- Screenshot: press F9 to take a screenshot and copy it to your clipboard, ready to paste into Discord with Ctrl+V.
  - Saved in screenshots/mineberry.
- Screenshots tab: see your screenshots (F2 ones too), then copy or open any of them.
- Chat Search: press F8 to search your chat history.
  - Results update as you type.
  - Copy any line with one click.

### Improved
- Safe Logout now follows the server's PvP mode messages instead of a 30 second timer.

### Fixed
- Safe Logout no longer re-enters combat after the server says you're out of PvP mode.
- Keybind names now show properly in the controls menu.

### Config
- combatSeconds is no longer used.

### Install
Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API and Java 25 or newer. Put the jar and Fabric API in your mods folder.

Full feature list and FAQ are in the README.

releases.notes:
## What's New in 1.4.0

### New HUD modules
Five new modules for the MineBerry Client HUD (press **Right Shift**). They are off by default, so turn them on from their cards.
- **Keystrokes / CPS:** W, A, S, D, both mouse buttons and Space light up while held, with the clicks per second of each mouse button
- **Armor Status:** your armor as item icons with the durability left
- **Potion Effects:** every visible effect with its level and time left
- **Compass:** a scrolling N / NE / E strip with your exact heading
- **Biome / Time:** the biome you are in and the in-game time of day

### Safe Logout
Don't quit in the middle of a fight by accident.
- Quitting is guarded for 30 seconds after combat, or until the server says combat is over
- Two modes: **warn** (the first try is refused, a second click quits) and **block** (quitting is refused until combat ends)
- The pause menu is guarded too
- Switch the mode with the gear on the Safe Logout card

### What's New popup
- After an update, a popup shows what changed, once
- Read the notes again any time with the **What's New** button in the Tools tab
- Turn it off with `"showChangelog": false` in the config file

### Improvements
- The HUD menu has `<` `>` page buttons (or use the mouse wheel) when there are more modules than fit
- When a screen corner is full, the next HUD modules start a second column instead of going off screen
- Fixes for Minecraft 26.2 (Safe Logout and the pause menu guard)

### Install
Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25+. Put the jar in your `mods` folder.
Do not install the standalone WorldEditCUI mod alongside this one.

Questions or bugs? Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/ApRvuNsX3j).

## MineBerry Essentials 1.3.1

A small update that fixes the update checker and lets you check by hand.

### Added
- **Check for updates** button in the Tools tab, under Updates. It shows "Checking...", then "You're up to date" or the new version, with an **Update** button that opens the download page. It works even if automatic checking is turned off, and you can press it again if a check fails.

### Fixed
- The update checker no longer fails on networks where GitHub's API is rate limited. It now uses a link that has no limit, and the API is only a fallback.

### Requirements
Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API, Java 25+. Do not install the standalone WorldEditCUI mod alongside this one.

### Download
Get `mineberry-essentials-1.3.1.jar` below and put it in your `mods`

releases.notes:
## MineBerry Essentials 1.3.0

A redesign of the Control Center, plus Quick Reply as its own module.

### Changed
- Control Center redesign: a new flat look with an orange accent.
  - Modules are now cards in a grid, each with an icon and an Enabled / Disabled button. Enabled cards get an orange line on top.
  - Hover a card to see what it does.
  - New default theme: dark grey with orange. The Aurora, Ember and Midnight themes are still available.
  - The panel adapts to your window size and GUI scale.
- The Control Center is split into two tabs: Modules and Tools.
- The coordinate converter, evidence export, Theme, Gradient and Update buttons moved to the Tools tab. A small orange dot on the Tools tab shows when an update is available.
- Close on danger and Chat timestamps are now regular cards in the grid.
- Quick Reply (/r) is now its own module with its own switch, separate from Chat Extras. It is on by default and your existing R keybind carries over. Chat Extras now covers only mentions and timestamps.
- The Website button in Mod Menu now opens the GitHub page instead of the Discord server.
- Fixed the author credit to ex.aerys.

### Added
- Category filter tabs in the Modules tab: All, Chat, Safety and Tools.
- Search box to find a module by name.
- Reset button to clear the category filter and the search.
- Scrollbar and mouse wheel scrolling when there are more modules than fit on screen.
- Settings gear on cards that have settings (Waypoints, WorldEdit CUI).

### Requirements
Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API, Java 25+. Do not install the standalone WorldEditCUI mod alongside this one.

### Download
Get `mineberry-essentials-1.3.0.jar` below and put it in your `mods` folder.

## MineBerry - Essentials 1.1.0

### Added
- **Chat Extras**, a new module in the Control Center
  - Mention highlight and sound: your name shows in bold gold and a sound plays when someone says it
  - Add extra mention words with `mentionNames` in `config/mineberry_essentials.json`
  - Optional `[HH:mm]` chat timestamps, switched with the **Stamps** button in the panel
  - Press `R` for Quick Reply, which opens chat with `/r ` already typed (rebindable)
- **Evidence Recorder**
  - Every log line now includes the date, time, your coordinates and the dimension
  - The reported player's name is copied to your clipboard when you confirm an alert or a kill is recorded (turn it off with `autoCopyReportedName`)
  - New **Copy** button in the panel copies the incident summary, ready to paste into a staff ticket

**Requirements:** Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API, Java 25+

Download the `.jar` below and put it in your `mods` folder.
Do not install the standalone WorldEditCUI mod alongside this one.

More features coming soon.
